gig_title: SharePoint Migration for Clinic File Server
short_description:
A two-outlet physiotherapy clinic with about 12 staff still runs shared files off an ageing on-premise server.

We need someone to move everything over to Microsoft 365 SharePoint: migrate the ~300GB of documents, rebuild a cleaner folder structure, set staff permissions so only the right people can reach files with personal data (PDPA), and verify nothing is missing before the old server is switched off. Deliverable: a fully migrated SharePoint site with permissions applied, a folder map, and a short handover document. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: MAS Environmental Risk Gap Review for Fund Manager
short_description: We run a small licensed fund management company in Singapore — about 15 staff, three private funds, no sustainability capability in-house. We need someone to review where we stand against the MAS Guidelines on Environmental Risk Management for asset managers: how environmental factors show up in our investment policies and due diligence, our portfolio monitoring, and what we disclose to investors. There are judgement calls on proportionality for a manager our size, so we want someone who can advise, not just tick boxes. Deliverable: a written gap assessment against the guidelines with a prioritised remediation roadmap for our board. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Viability Review for F&B Group
short_description:
I run a family-owned F&B group with three outlets and an SFA-licensed central kitchen, about 45 staff. I need an independent business review that looks hard at whether each outlet is viable: margins, footfall, lease costs, and the central kitchen's break-even. You would dig into our POS and Xero data, test our assumptions, and sit with my directors to talk through options — consolidation, closure, or a different model.

Deliverable: a written viability report with per-outlet scenarios and clear recommendations. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Redesign of Client Pitch Deck
short_description:
We run a five-person IP firm in Singapore, handling trade mark and patent filings with IPOS for local SMEs. Our client pitch deck has grown to 30-odd slides and no longer hangs together. We'd like someone to review it, diagnose where the story and layout fall short, recommend a cleaner structure and design system, and rework the slides to match — typography, colour, spacing, the lot.

Deliverable: a reworked 25-slide PowerPoint deck with a reusable slide master, plus a one-page note of recommendations. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$2,000-2,500; we'd like the work to start in the first week of July.

gig_title: PDPA Member Advisory with Compliance Checklist
short_description:
Looking for a researcher who knows Singapore's PDPA inside out to draft a member advisory for our association. We represent about 200 small retailers and F&B operators across the island; the secretariat is four people with no in-house legal or compliance capability.

The work: review the Act and the PDPC's advisory guidelines plus recent enforcement decisions, pull out what actually matters for small businesses handling customer data, and write it up in plain English. Deliverable: an 8-10 page member advisory with a one-page self-check checklist, in Word and PDF. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Construction Production Delay Review and Recovery Plan
short_description:
We need an independent review of production delays on our eight-storey mixed-use development (about 60 residential units over two shop levels). We're a small family developer with no in-house construction team, and Temporary Occupation Permit (TOP) from BCA is at risk.

The specialist will review the master programme, recent progress reports and subcontractor records, diagnose where production is being lost, and advise what is realistically recoverable by handover. Deliverable: a written assessment with a prioritised recovery plan, including recommended sequencing and resourcing changes. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Dysphagia Assessments for Nursing Home Residents
short_description:
I run a 92-bed MOH-licensed nursing home. I need a speech therapist to carry out clinical swallow assessments for ten residents flagged for aspiration risk, mostly post-stroke or with Parkinson's, and to set IDDSI levels and safe-swallowing recommendations for each. You'll review their hospital discharge summaries and any videofluoroscopy reports, run the bedside assessments with our nurses observing, and brief the kitchen and care teams on the changes.

Deliverable: ten completed swallow assessment reports with diet and fluid recommendations, written up for our clinical records. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Omni-Channel Returns Process Map and Fixes
short_description:
We need our online returns process sorted out. We're a family-run footwear retailer — three outlets, a webstore and two local marketplace listings, about 25 staff.

Want someone to trace a return from request to refund across each channel, flag where it jams — marketplace turnaround times, store credit, PDPA on customer data — and advise what to fix first. Deliverable: a channel-by-channel returns process map with handoffs and a short prioritised fixes list. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Gap Review of Depot Track Inspection Process
short_description:
We need an independent review of how our depot track inspections are planned and recorded. We're a small rail maintenance contractor, about 35 staff, doing depot track and switches maintenance works. We want a track maintenance specialist to map our current inspection workflow and check the process and records against what LTA expects under the Rapid Transit Systems Act and our own work instructions. From there, advise which gaps matter most and what a revised process could look like.

Deliverable: a written gap assessment with prioritised recommendations for the inspection process and record-keeping. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: PDPA Compliance Gap Review for Physiotherapy Clinic Group
short_description:
We run three physiotherapy clinics with about 25 staff and hold patient records plus a marketing list of a few thousand contacts. We need a legal specialist to assess how we collect, store, use and share personal data against the PDPA: review consent notices on our booking forms and at the front desk, check our clinic management software and vendor agreements, and tell us where we fall short.

You would sit with the two directors to explain the gaps and advise what fixing each one involves. Deliverable: a written gap assessment with prioritised remediation actions, plus redrafted consent wording for the front desk, booking forms and website. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Clean Up and Restructure HSE Excel Workbook
short_description:
We need our messy HSE Excel workbook sorted out. We are a lubricants blending SME; the file holds three years of incident reports and our SDS register across nine tabs. Review the file, diagnose the structural problems, merge duplicate sheets, standardise the entries, and rebuild the registers with working dropdowns and formulas. Incident data must stay retrievable for WSH Act reporting.

Deliverable: the restructured workbook plus a one-page note recommending how to keep it clean. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Learning Needs Assessment for Preschool Child
short_description:
We run a single-site preschool with about 80 children, from playgroup to K2. One of our K1 children needs an independent opinion on persistent speech and pre-literacy difficulties before we decide on a referral for early intervention. You would observe across several sessions, run standardised screenings, write up the findings, then sit with our teachers and the parents to talk it through.

Deliverable: a written learning-needs report with recommended classroom strategies and a referral recommendation, to support an application under ECDA's DS-LS programme. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Process Mapping and SOPs for Sauce Production Line
short_description: A family-run sauce manufacturer with around 15 staff operates one SFA-licensed production line and has no documented procedures for it. We need someone to spend time on the floor mapping how a batch moves from cooking through filling to packing, then turn that into clear, step-by-step SOPs the line crew can actually follow. While you are at it, advise us on two or three practical improvements — spots where timing slips or where records are easy to get wrong. Deliverable: a process map plus 8-10 written SOPs for the line, as editable soft copies. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: WSH Compliance Gap Review for Machining Workshop
short_description: We need a workplace safety and health compliance check done on our precision machining workshop — around 25 staff on one floor, CNC turning and milling. You would review machine guarding, lockout practice and our risk assessment register against the Workplace Safety and Health Act and the WSH (Risk Management) Regulations. That means walking the shop floor with the production lead and checking that training records and permit-to-work files are current. Deliverable: a written gap report with prioritised corrective actions and an updated risk assessment register in Excel. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: ISM Code Gap Review for Tanker SMS
short_description: We run four small product tankers on regional coastal routes and need an independent gap review of our Safety Management System. We're a family-owned operator with a shore team of six and no in-house auditor. The work: check our SMS manual, procedures, drill and maintenance records against the ISM Code and MPA requirements, interview the shore team and our masters, and flag where documentation and actual practice diverge. Deliverable: a written gap report mapping findings to ISM elements with prioritised corrective actions. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Courtyard Garden Planting for Boutique Hotel
short_description:
Looking for a landscape implementation specialist to plant out the courtyard garden of our 24-room boutique hotel. We already have a designer's planting plan covering about 90 m² of beds — mostly shade-tolerant species, ferns, heliconias and some NParks-recommended natives.

You would prepare the beds, source the plants from local nurseries, install them to the plan, mulch, and set up a drip irrigation line on a timer connected to our existing water point. One courtyard only, no other sites. Deliverable: finished, planted courtyard beds with irrigation running on timers and an as-planted schedule matching the plan. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Transcription and Summaries of Recorded Interviews
short_description:
Looking for a specialist in transcribing and summarising recorded interviews. We're a small security consultancy in Singapore. For an incident review we recorded eight witness interviews, about nine hours of audio with cross-talk and some Singlish. You would produce verbatim transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps, then a structured summary of each interview covering facts, timeline points and contradictions between accounts. Accuracy matters: excerpts may be quoted in a report to the PDPC under the PDPA.

Deliverable: verbatim transcripts for all eight interviews, a 2-page summary of each and one combined chronology. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$1,800–2,500 for the full package.

gig_title: SSG Learner Records and Funding Claim Review
short_description:
I run a small training provider in Singapore, about 12 staff, six WSQ courses with SkillsFuture funding and roughly 500 enrolments a year. I need an independent review of our learner records, attendance tracking and funding-claim processes against current SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) requirements. Read them the way an SSG auditor would. Flag where our evidence trail would not hold up and what to fix first.

Deliverable: a written gap assessment with a prioritised remediation plan covering records, claims and LMS configuration. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$5,000–S$7,000; can start any time from early June.

gig_title: Engineering Drawings for New Bottling Line
short_description: We need a set of engineering drawings for a new bottling line going into our SFA-licensed beverage factory. The line runs about 1,800 bottles an hour across 14 machines. Looking for a specialist to visit the site once, measure the space, and prepare a general arrangement layout, a piping schematic and an equipment schedule. Standard 2D AutoCAD outputs our contractor can build from, nothing exotic. Deliverable: a DWG and PDF drawing pack covering layout, piping and equipment schedule. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: IMDA Registration File for 2.4 GHz Smart Sensor
short_description: Looking for an electronics engineer to take our 2.4 GHz smart sensor through IMDA equipment registration. The work covers reviewing the existing CISPR 32 and EN 300 328 pre-compliance data, reworking two areas of the PCB layout in Altium for EMC, booking and overseeing formal tests at an accredited local lab, and drafting the technical file and declaration of conformity. We're a 12-person hardware startup; this is our first radio product. Deliverable: a submission-ready registration technical file with the lab test reports. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Employee Grievance and Discipline Review for Logistics Firm
short_description:
We run a family-owned logistics firm with about 130 staff across drivers, warehouse crew and office roles. We want an independent review of how we handle employee grievances and discipline, checked against the Employment Act and Tripartite Guidelines. You would interview a sample of staff and line supervisors, review our current grievance channel, disciplinary letters and exit records, and diagnose where our practice falls short.

We need practical fixes a small HR team can run with. Deliverable: a written assessment with prioritised recommendations and a 6-month action roadmap for management sign-off. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Preferential Origin Determination for Regional Exports
short_description:
A family-owned fastener manufacturer in Singapore, about 35 staff, exporting 40 per cent of output to Indonesia and Vietnam under its own Singapore Customs permits. We want an independent trade compliance specialist to determine whether our top 20 product lines qualify for preferential tariffs under RCEP and ATIGA, running tariff-shift and regional value content tests against our bills of materials. You would sit with our logistics coordinator and clearing agent to walk through the findings and close gaps in our origin records.

Deliverable: a written origin determination for each product line, with working papers and a short list of documentation fixes. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Clean Up and Restructure Hotel Sales Excel Workbook
short_description:
I run a 58-room boutique hotel in Singapore. Our sales workbook has three years of corporate enquiries, OTA bookings and commissions across a dozen tabs, full of merged cells, broken pivots and duplicate client entries. I need someone to review it, diagnose what is broken and recommend a clean structure to rebuild around; guest contact data is in there, so PDPA-aware handling matters.

Deliverable: a written assessment with a recommended tab and field layout, standard formulas and a clean-up plan. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Venue Operations Review for Attractions Licence Renewal
short_description:
Looking for a venue operations specialist to carry out an independent review of our day-to-day operations before we renew our STB Attractions Licence. We run a heritage attraction across two conserved buildings, about 25 staff, weekend peaks of 600+ visitors.

We need someone to assess visitor flow, queue and capacity management, evacuation routes, and how we supervise contractors on site, then recommend practical fixes. Deliverable: a written operational assessment with prioritised recommendations and evidence we can attach to the licence renewal. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$10,000–S$14,000, and the review must start by the first week of March.

gig_title: Financial Education Video Quality Assurance Review
short_description: Looking for a media quality assurance specialist to review finished financial education videos. The scope covers 24 videos, each 2-5 minutes, from a small MAS-regulated financial services distributor with 15 staff. You will check captions, audio levels, on-screen text, disclosures, brand usage, and basic accessibility, then advise management on corrections before client distribution. Deliverable: a QA report with a defect list, severity ratings, and recommended fixes, plus a short guidance note for the content team. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget range: S$4,000 to S$6,000.

gig_title: Lockout-Tagout Procedures for Machining Workshop
short_description: We need lockout-tagout procedures written for our machining workshop. The specialist should watch how our crew does machine changeovers and maintenance, map each step, then draft LOTO procedures for twelve machines and advise my two supervisors on rolling them out. Deliverable: machine-specific LOTO procedures aligned to the Workplace Safety and Health Act (MOM), plus one walkthrough session with the crew. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$4,500-6,000; can start in early March.

gig_title: HACCP Plan Development for Central Kitchen
short_description:
We're a family-run F&B operator with one central kitchen prepping sauces and cooked dishes for nine hawker stalls.

We need a culinary specialist to build our HACCP plan from scratch: map process flows for our 40-odd recipes, identify CCPs with critical limits, and draft the monitoring, corrective-action and verification records to SFA requirements. Flag any equipment or workflow changes we'd need — honest gaps, not a shelf document. Deliverable: the full HACCP plan pack with flow diagrams, hazard analysis, CCP worksheets and monitoring record forms, ready for audit. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Review Carbon Credit Broker Terms for 500 tCO2e Purchase
short_description: Looking for a carbon credit trading adviser to review a proposed purchase for a small Singapore logistics SME, about 40 staff and 2 warehouse sites. The company plans to buy around 500 tCO2e of Verified Carbon Standard credits from one broker for its planned offset purchase. Review the broker's term sheet, fee schedule, serial-number retirement process, project documentation, and two comparable offers. Advise on likely pitfalls, key questions, and a simple procurement checklist. Deliverable: a one-page assessment with recommended broker terms, credit-type ranking, and a short procurement checklist. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Sterile Fill-Finish Compliance and Cost Review
short_description: A Singapore contract manufacturer produces sterile injectable biopharmaceuticals. A management specialist will run a targeted HSA GMP gap and cost review of one fill-finish line, covering 14 SOPs, 3 months of batch records, and cleaning validation data. Identify gaps, rank remediation actions, and prepare savings for changeovers, consumables, and maintenance. Deliverable: a completed report with a ranked action plan, budgeted savings, and updated log. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget range is S$18,000 to S$24,000.

gig_title: First Article Inspection Packages for Machined Parts
short_description:
We run a 25-person precision machining shop in Singapore, AS9100D certified, making aluminium and titanium parts for CAAS-approved aerospace manufacturers. We need a specialist to prepare first article inspection packages for 10 part numbers to AS9102 Rev C — ballooning the drawings, completing Forms 1, 2 and 3, cross-checking characteristic tolerances against our CMM reports, and flagging anything out of spec for our review. Measurements can be taken on our Zeiss CMM, with our shop-floor team on hand for support.

Deliverable: complete FAI packages for all 10 part numbers, ready to submit to our customer. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Gas Pipeline Integrity Review and Licence Renewal
short_description:
Our single-site food factory runs on a private piped natural gas network under an EMA gas installation licence. We need a gas pipeline engineer to review our inspection records and close-interval survey data, run a fitness-for-service assessment to ASME B31.8, advise on remedial scope and renewal strategy, and draft the licence renewal submission.

Deliverable: a signed fitness-for-service report plus a renewal submission ready to file. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Central Kitchen Waste Collection Review
short_description: We operate a central kitchen for 6 food delivery outlets in Singapore. We need a waste collection consultant to review how food waste, packaging, and general waste are stored, collected, and handed over to licensed collectors. You will inspect schedules, container sizes, compactor settings, and disposal records, then compare them with NEA waste collection requirements and cost drivers. Please flag compliance gaps, practical process changes, and likely savings. Deliverable: a one-page summary, a full review report with a revised collection plan, and a 45-minute walkthrough for operations managers. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Venue Tech Pack for 90-Seat Black Box
short_description:
We're a 90-seat black box theatre run by a small arts charity. Our tech info is scattered across old paperwork and a part-time technician's memory, and we need a production specialist to pull it into one venue tech pack: stage and seating dimensions, masking, lighting patch and channel hookup for our 24-channel desk, sound input list, power and comms, plus an inventory of the cable and rigging store. You'd verify everything against the space and advise us on what to update before each show and for IMDA licence applications.

Deliverable: a venue tech pack in PDF and editable form, with a short list of gaps to fix. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Self-Harm Response Protocol for Student Care Centre
short_description:
We run a student care centre with 120 children aged 7 to 14 and just one part-time counsellor. We need a clinical counsellor or psychologist to draft a protocol staff can follow the moment a child shows signs of self-harm or suicidal thinking: how to screen on the spot, when to call parents, and what the Children and Young Persons Act requires of us.

You would adapt a validated screening tool for this age group and build the escalation flowchart covering handover to school counsellors and hospital crisis teams. Deliverable: a finished protocol document with screening checklist, escalation flowchart and case-note template. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Diagnosis of Recurring Fish Mortality
short_description: We need an independent opinion on recurring mortality at our coastal fish farm — around 40 sea cages with grouper and seabass. Review our stocking, feeding and net hygiene practices, go through our water quality logs, walk the site, and give a defensible view on the likely causes and what to change. Deliverable: a written diagnostic report with root-cause findings and prioritised recommendations, suitable for sharing with SFA. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$12,000–15,000; must be able to start within two weeks.

gig_title: Wholesale Procurement Cost and Sourcing Review
short_description:
Our wholesale distribution team needs a sourcing and procurement advisor to review how we purchase, qualify, and reprice supplier products.

We distribute about 120 SKUs of packaging materials across three Singapore warehouses, and current lead times and landed costs are inconsistent. Please review supplier contracts, order patterns, import documentation, and stock movement data, then advise on category-level sourcing options, alternate supplier criteria, and a 90-day roadmap.
Deliverable: an assessment memo with prioritised recommendations and a supplier review plan.
Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Flexible Work Arrangement Section for Staff Handbook
short_description: Looking for a freelance HR writer to draft a new section for our staff handbook on flexible work arrangement requests. We're a 45-person airfield systems maintenance contractor; most crews work rotating shifts, with about 10 office staff. You'd map how requests are handled today into a proper workflow, align it with MOM's Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangement Requests, and write the policy in plain English our shift supervisors can use. Deliverable: a 4-6 page handbook section in Word, plus a one-page request form and approval flowchart. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Internal Control Gap Review for Financial Reporting
short_description: Looking for an assurance reviewer to assess internal controls over financial reporting for a 25-person Singapore distribution company. Review revenue, procurement, inventory, payroll and tax documentation, test transaction samples, and check how key controls respond to month-end close. Identify gaps against COSO and ISAE 3000, rank issues by risk, and advise directors on fixes. Deliverable: a 12-15 page control gap assessment with findings, risk ratings, and a remediation roadmap. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget range: S$9,000-S$14,000.

gig_title: Drawing Approval Workflow Review for Ship Repair Yard
short_description:
We run a small ship repair yard, about 35 staff, mainly harbour craft and barges. We need a marine design engineer to review how our drawings and technical documents are prepared, checked and submitted to class and MPA, diagnose where jobs get held up, and recommend a leaner approval workflow.

Deliverable: a written assessment of the current process plus recommended steps and simple checklists for drawing review. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Spec and Prototype for In-App Claim Upload
short_description:
We want patients to upload insurance claim documents through our clinic booking app, and the feature needs proper specs before our dev shop builds it. We run six physiotherapy clinics; the app is externally built and there's no product person in-house. The work is to settle how uploads handle consent, storage and staff access under the PDPA, map the data flows, pick defensible retention periods, and draft the specs the developers build from, including the consent wording.

Deliverable: a final feature specification, a clickable Figma prototype, consent copy and a short data-flow map, ready to hand to the developers. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$14,000–18,000 for the whole engagement, invoiced at milestones.

gig_title: SFO Exemption and AML/CFT Gap Review
short_description:
I run a single-family office in Singapore, six of us investing for one family across listed equities and private funds.

I need a compliance specialist to check where we stand against the MAS exemption conditions for single-family offices and our AML/CFT obligations — reviewing our policies, KYC and source-of-wealth files, and ongoing monitoring, then sitting down with me and our investment lead to talk through what needs fixing first and what can wait. Deliverable: a written gap assessment with a prioritised remediation plan, walked through at a closing session. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Physiotherapy Clinic Booking Flow Redesign
short_description: Looking for a UI/UX designer to redo our online appointment booking flow. We run a physiotherapy clinic with 3 outlets; patients book through a web form that's clunky on phones. The job: review our current 6-step booking flow, advise which steps to cut or merge, then redesign the screens in Figma, including the consent step where patients enter personal details (PDPA applies). Deliverable: a Figma file with the redesigned mobile screens plus a one-page note on what changed and why. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Freedom-to-Operate Opinion for Handheld Diagnostic
short_description:
I run a 12-person medtech startup and need a registered Singapore patent agent to prepare a freedom-to-operate opinion before we launch a handheld point-of-care diagnostic (HSA Class B). We've shortlisted 7 patent families (Singapore, US, PCT) covering our assay method and reader hardware.

The work: map each family's independent claims against our device, build claim charts, flag ambiguous claim terms, assess infringement exposure and note validity weaknesses. Deliverable: a written FTO opinion with claim charts per family, a low/medium/high infringement risk rating for each, and design-around options for any problem claims. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Mystery Shopping Visits for Member Outlets
short_description:
We need an independent mystery shopper to visit ten of our member outlets across Singapore and score each against our service excellence checklist, which is aligned to CaseTrust standards. Each visit covers the full customer journey — walk-in, purchase, query handling, follow-up — with notes and evidence (timestamps, receipts) for every score. We will brief you on the checklist; you'll also flag where the scoring is ambiguous and advise how to tighten it for future rounds. Scores must be consistent and defensible, as members will see them and some may dispute theirs.

Deliverable: a scored report per outlet plus a one-page consolidated summary with observed patterns and quick fixes.
Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Power BI Dashboard for Project Status and Fees
short_description:
We are a small architecture practice in Singapore: 12 staff, eight to ten live projects. Project figures are scattered across Excel files, so the directors size up resourcing by feel. We want one Power BI dashboard to run the practice from.

The work: sit with us, review how stage, fee drawdown, BCA submission dates and manpower are tracked, recommend the handful of metrics that matter, then clean the data and build it. Deliverable: a working Power BI dashboard covering status, fees and manpower, plus a note on monthly upkeep. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Therapy Documentation Gap Review for Day Rehab Centre
short_description:
I run a day rehabilitation centre for older adults, about 40 clients through the doors each week. We're licensed by MOH under the Healthcare Services Act, and I need a therapy specialist to go through our assessments, session records, care plans and equipment checks against the licence conditions, then draft updated templates and protocols wherever we fall short. Most of the work can be done remotely with two half-days onsite.

Deliverable: a gap report plus a complete set of refreshed therapy assessment and documentation templates. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$4,500-6,000, and the specialist must be AHPC-registered (physiotherapy or occupational therapy).

gig_title: Supplement Marketing Claims Compliance Review
short_description:
We're a family-run supplements retailer with three outlets and a webstore, and we need our marketing claims checked against HSA advertising rules. You would review about 60 live assets — shelf talkers, webstore listings, Facebook and Instagram ads, influencer captions — for anything that overstates benefits or implies a product treats a condition, rank the risks, and rewrite the ones that fail.

We also want a plain-English do-and-don't claims guide for our marketing staff and a briefing for our two managers on what we can safely say. Deliverable: a findings report ranking every claim green/amber/red, corrected replacements for all flagged assets, and the claims guide. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Rewrite Track Access and Dispatch SOPs
short_description:
We need our track access and train dispatch procedures rewritten to match current LTA rail safety requirements. We run a small automated people mover serving an entertainment precinct: about 30 staff, a depot and four stations, and roughly 320 trains a day.

You would sit with our controllers and maintenance crew to map how access requests, protection and handbacks really flow, then write clear, plain-language SOPs and flag anything that clashes with our operating licence. Deliverable: 6-8 revised SOPs plus a half-day briefing session for our operations team. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: PDPA Legal Opinion for Dental Clinic Group
short_description:
Looking for a lawyer to give us a written opinion on patient data handling under the PDPA. We run six dental clinics and are moving all patient records onto one cloud booking system. We need to know what consent we actually hold, what moving records between clinics requires, and where our current forms fall short.

Deliverable: a written legal opinion with a risk assessment and recommended fixes to our consent forms and privacy notices. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Redesign of Product Development Review Deck
short_description:
We are a Singapore chemicals SME blending water treatment products for factories and buildings, about 35 staff. Our product development review deck for management is 50-plus slides of trial data and cost tables, and buries the go/no-go decisions. We want a presentation specialist to review it, diagnose where the story breaks, advise what to cut, and rebuild it with decision-ready charts (dosing costs in S$, NEA effluent limits).

Deliverable: a redesigned PowerPoint deck of 15-20 slides plus a one-page note on structure and messaging. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: SPARK Readiness Review for Childcare Centre
short_description:
We run a childcare centre in the east with six classrooms and about 75 children. We want an early childhood education specialist to review our programme documentation and classroom practices against the ECDA SPARK framework, and advise what to change before we apply for certification.

Deliverable: a written gap analysis with prioritised recommendations for each level (Playgroup to K2). Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$2,500-3,500; hoping to start in early September.

gig_title: Reformulate Chrysanthemum Tea to Nutri-Grade B
short_description:
A family-run beverage bottler in Singapore, about 15 staff at one production site, needs its top-selling chrysanthemum tea reformulated to hit Nutri-Grade B. We need a food scientist to take sugar down from roughly 8g to 5g per 100ml using a stevia-based system, running bench trials on sweetness, acidity and mouthfeel, then scaling the winning version to a pilot batch on our hot-fill line. Accelerated shelf-life testing, plus a small sensory panel with our staff, should back the final choice.

Deliverable: a finished formulation sheet with ingredient specifications, adjusted pasteurisation parameters, and a shelf-life report supporting the Nutri-Grade B declaration under SFA's Food Regulations. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Measurement Uncertainty Budget for SINGLAS Calibration Scope
short_description:
We are a 25-person precision machining firm in Singapore making components for medical device customers. We want to add a dimensional calibration scope under SAC-SINGLAS and need a metrology specialist to work it through with us. The job: draft the uncertainty budget for one gauge calibration scope, validate our CMM method against it, and advise us on gaps to close before the accreditation assessment.

Deliverable: an assessment-ready uncertainty budget, method validation record and written gap list for one scope. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$18,000–S$25,000; we would like the work to start by end of next month.

gig_title: Port Call Documentation Templates and Process Map
short_description:
We run a small ship agency in Singapore — eight staff, handling around a dozen feeder and bulk vessel calls a month. Each call means the same stack of submissions to MPA and PortNet, but every agent rebuilds theirs from old emails, so formats drift.

You'd map the document flow for a standard call (pre-arrival notices, crew lists, health and immigration declarations, statement of facts, disbursement accounts), then draft a master template set with naming conventions. Deliverable: a completed template pack for one typical call plus a one-page process map. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Arborist Report for NParks Tree Felling Application
short_description:
We want a consulting arborist to assess a mature rain tree overhanging our carpark and put together the report for an NParks felling application. The condo has about 300 units and the canopy spreads over roughly 20 parking lots. Work covers a level 2 visual tree assessment, decay testing with a resistograph or sonic tomograph if needed, a soil and root-zone check, and a written risk evaluation with a firm recommendation to retain, prune or remove.

Deliverable: a submission-ready arborist report and tree risk assessment with photos, findings and recommendation that we can attach to the NParks application. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Physical Security Review of Customs-Bonded Warehouse
short_description: I run a family-owned logistics firm with one Customs-bonded warehouse (~6,000 sqm, 28 staff) holding high-value electronics. I need an independent physical security review of the site against our Singapore Customs licence conditions: walk the site day and night, check CCTV and alarm coverage, access control, gatehouse and out-of-hours procedures, seal handling and record-keeping, and talk to the shift leads. Deliverable: a written gap assessment against the licence conditions, with prioritised recommendations that separate must-fix gaps from optional upgrades. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Training Needs Analysis for Warehouse Operations Team
short_description:
Looking for an adult education specialist to run a training needs analysis for our warehouse and operations team. We're a 40-person logistics SME, one site, no in-house training function.

You would review job roles and current workflows, run a short staff survey, and interview the four team leads to diagnose skill gaps. Deliverable: a findings report ranking the priority gaps, with a recommended 12-month training roadmap mapped to SkillsFuture-eligible courses and a view on build-versus-buy. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Project Finance Model for 1.8 MWp Rooftop Solar
short_description:
We are a 12-person solar engineering firm developing a 1.8 MWp rooftop array on one industrial building, to be EMA-licensed, with a signed 20-year power purchase agreement. We want a project finance model built from scratch. That means S$2.4 million capex phasing, PPA tariff revenue, O&M and inverter replacement costs, debt sizing, DSCR and gearing covenant tests, and downside sensitivities on tariff, yield and interest rates.

Deliverable: a bankable Excel model with documented assumptions and a two-page financing summary for lender talks. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Production Workflow Mapping and Job Tracking Setup
short_description:
A small electronics contract assembler in Singapore runs about 15 orders a month through a single SMT line, with roughly 25 production staff, and tracks jobs on paper and WhatsApp.

We want someone to map the production workflow from incoming parts to final test, document each step in a standard process map, and recommend one affordable job-tracking tool suited to the shop floor. Advise us on where steps can be simplified, then set the tool up with a few sample live jobs. Deliverable: a documented workflow map with step notes and a configured tracking tool, handed over with a short walkthrough. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Rewrite 12 Job Adverts for F&B Roles
short_description: Family-run F&B group with six outlets and a central kitchen, around 70 staff. Looking for someone to rewrite the job adverts for the roles we hire most often — service crew, kitchen helpers, outlet supervisors and a few central kitchen positions — into one clear house template, with wording checked against TAFEP fair hiring guidelines. Pay range and working hours are already settled; the work is shaping them into ads people actually read. Deliverable: 12 finalised job adverts in the house template, plus a short careers page blurb for our website. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: LTA Compliance Review for Goods Vehicle Fleet
short_description:
We are a family-run building materials supplier with nine lorries and twelve drivers making site deliveries across Singapore.

We need someone to review our transport operations — vehicle records, driver licence classes, load limits, daily trip logs, maintenance and periodic inspection schedules — against LTA requirements, and flag where we are exposed. Deliverable: a written compliance gap assessment with a prioritised fix list. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000–8,000; must start in the first week of June.

gig_title: Proofread and Copy-Edit Housekeeping Operations Manual
short_description:
We run a 230-room hotel in Singapore. Our housekeeping operations manual — about 45,000 words over 12 chapters covering room cleaning, trolley set-up, linen handling, chemical safety and lost-and-found — needs a careful proofread and copy-edit. You would correct grammar, tighten wordy sections, keep terminology uniform, make our citations to MOM's Workplace Safety and Health Act consistent, and flag anything that reads ambiguously or contradicts another section rather than fixing it quietly. Where wording affects staff training or safety, we want your recommendation.

Deliverable: the manual in Word with tracked changes, a clean final copy, and a short memo of flagged sections with suggested fixes. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Trust Account and Refunds Compliance Review
short_description:
We're a licensed travel agency — 30 staff, three outlets — mainly package tours and flight-plus-hotel bookings. We want an independent review of our customer-money handling — trust account, refunds, cancellations — against the Travel Agents Act, STB licence conditions and the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act.

You'd work through booking records, ledgers and complaint files, flag where we fall short, and advise our ops lead while we draft corrective procedures. Deliverable: a written gap-assessment report with a prioritised remediation plan to table at our licence renewal. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Netcode and Backend Review for Live Mobile Game
short_description:
Looking for a multiplayer networking specialist to review our live game's technical architecture. We're a 14-person studio with one live title on iOS and Android, about 90,000 monthly players and 12,000 matches a day. Stack: Unity client, custom C# authoritative servers over UDP on AWS (Singapore and Tokyo regions), a matchmaker and a Postgres account store.

We need an independent diagnosis of the peak-hour desync and latency, a call on whether the setup can take 3x growth, and a PDPA check on how accounts and payments are handled. Deliverable: a written assessment with prioritised recommendations and a remediation roadmap. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$10,000–15,000; ready to start within two weeks of award.

gig_title: Workplace Safety System Audit for Cold Chain Warehouse
short_description:
We are a Singapore cold chain distributor with about 30 staff at one warehouse. We need a WSH auditor to review our existing safety system, map its processes, and check them against the WSH Act and regulations. The work covers SOPs, equipment checklists, incident records, PPE use, manual handling, and delivery safety, with limited site observation.
Deliverable: a completed audit report, gap list, updated checklists, and corrective action templates.
Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Table Service Review and Shift Checklist
short_description:
I run a casual dining café with three outlets in Singapore and no dedicated ops person. I need someone to review our table service: spend a few shifts watching the floor during lunch rush and quiet evenings, note where orders get delayed, bills sit uncleared and shift handovers break down, then talk me through which two or three fixes are worth trying first and how to brief the floor team. We do about 400 covers a day across the three shops.

Deliverable: a short findings report plus a one-page shift checklist covering service steps and the SFA hygiene points our floor leads should be checking. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Carbon Credit Feasibility Assessment for Biogas Capture
short_description:
A family-owned food waste recycler in Singapore, NEA-licensed and handling about 4,000 tonnes a year, wants to know if its biogas capture can be registered as a carbon project.

Looking for a specialist to review two years of operating data, screen the project against Verra VCS and Gold Standard methodologies, assess additionality, and recommend whether registration is worth pursuing. An indicative annual credit estimate and a rough registration roadmap should be included. Deliverable: a feasibility assessment report with recommended methodology, estimated credit volumes and a go/no-go call. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: cGMP Gap Review for Aseptic Filling Line
short_description:
We run a single aseptic filling line at our HSA-licensed contract manufacturing suite and need an independent review of our cGMP compliance against PIC/S. The work: walk the line, review batch records, SOPs and the past year of deviations and change controls, then sit down with our production and QA management to talk through what you find.

Deliverable: a written gap report with risk-rated findings, references to the affected procedures, and a prioritised remediation plan. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Fleet Utilisation Dashboard and Maintenance Review
short_description:
A Singapore-based charter operator with six turboprop aircraft needs a specialist to review its fleet records and build a management dashboard. You would consolidate monthly utilisation, defect and maintenance-due data from our tracking tool's Excel exports, flag anything overdue against our CAAS-approved maintenance programme, and diagnose where downtime and standby costs are concentrated. We want utilisation, availability and upcoming maintenance readable at a glance, plus your recommendations on maintenance scheduling and spares holding.

Deliverable: a Power BI fleet dashboard plus a short findings memo with prioritised recommendations. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$8,000-12,000; must start by the first week of April.

gig_title: Independent Grid Protection Settings Review for Warehouse Solar-Battery
short_description:
A family-owned industrial landlord runs a single warehouse block with a 900 kWp rooftop solar array and a 1 MWh battery, grid-connected under EMA's Distribution Code.

We want an independent review of the site's protection relay settings, anti-islanding scheme and export limit against the grid connection agreement. Flag any compliance or coordination gaps, then sit with our facilities team to talk through what should change. Deliverable: a signed written opinion with a marked-up settings schedule and a 90-minute walkthrough of the findings. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: WSH Risk Assessments for Recycling Yard
short_description: We run a metal recycling yard, about 30 staff, and need a full set of workplace safety and health risk assessments drawn up. Looking for an EHS specialist to walk the site, interview supervisors and operators, and draft risk assessments for our main activities: shearing, baling, forklift and crane operations, gas cutting, and yard traffic. It must line up with the WSH Act and the WSH (Risk Management) Regulations, and hold up at an MOM inspection or a bizSAFE audit. Deliverable: a complete risk assessment register covering all yard activities, a gap report on our current documents, and safe work procedures for the five highest-risk tasks. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Stage Rigging Plot and Load Calculations
short_description: Looking for a theatrical rigger to prepare the rigging plot for a small theatre company's six-show run at a 400-seat drama centre. Work covers point loads and bridle details across 28 motorised points, a weight schedule for the flown set, and checks against the venue's loading limits and the Workplace Safety and Health Act. Deliverable: a venue-ready rigging plot with load calculations and weight schedule, in Vectorworks and PDF. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Mental Capacity Assessment for Deputyship Application
short_description:
We run four group homes for adults with intellectual disabilities and need a formal mental capacity assessment for one resident, to support a deputyship application under the Mental Capacity Act.

You would be a clinical psychologist working solo: interview the resident (a man in his 40s with mild intellectual disability), review collateral from our social workers and his family, apply the two-stage test from the Code of Practice, and assess his capacity for specific decisions on personal welfare and finances. A cognitive screen (ACE-III or similar) should inform the opinion. Deliverable: a signed assessment report structured for submission to the Office of the Public Guardian, with clear reasoning for each decision. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Readiness Review Before Adding Ready-to-Eat Line
short_description:
We run an SFA-licensed sauce and paste factory with about 60 staff, and we want to add a chilled ready-to-eat meals line, which means a licence variation.

We need an independent adviser to review our factory layout, food safety management, supply chain and staffing against what that category demands, and advise whether to proceed and how. Deliverable: a written assessment for our board with a clear go/no-go recommendation and a phased readiness roadmap. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: GST and Transfer Pricing Review for Wholesale Distributor
short_description: A Singapore wholesale distributor of industrial packaging with 18 staff and S$12m revenue needs a finance regulations specialist to review cross-border pricing and GST positions. The specialist should test intercompany sale terms against IRAS transfer pricing expectations, sample 120 invoices and 24 purchase orders, and advise management on remediation. Deliverable: a written review with exception list, pricing adjustment calculations, and a management memo. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Passenger Complaint SOP for Ground Handling Desk
short_description:
Looking for someone to map and document our passenger complaint handling process. We are a CAAS-licensed ground handling agent at Changi; our desk of about 20 staff handles roughly 300 complaints and requests a month by email, phone and counter.

You would trace the current flow, draft a clear SOP with reply templates and escalation steps, and advise us on fixes. Deliverable: complaint handling SOP with escalation matrix and templates. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000 to S$9,000 for the full engagement.

gig_title: Unaudited Financial Statements for Trading Firm
short_description:
A family-owned kitchen equipment trading firm with about 15 staff, running its books on Xero. We need a specialist to prepare the FY2024 unaudited financial statements from the Xero trial balance — tidy up the general ledger and accruals, reconcile the fixed asset register, and draft the primary statements with supporting notes under SFRS for Small Entities.

Prior-year accounts and full Xero access will be provided, and we can answer questions by email. Deliverable: a complete set of unaudited financial statements (statement of financial position, statement of profit or loss, and supporting notes) in Word and PDF, ready for director sign-off. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: English-Chinese Translation of Shipyard Safety Procedures
short_description:
I need a technical translator — English to simplified Chinese — for our marine fabrication yard's safe work procedures. It's about 15,000 words: hot work, confined space entry, lifting. Our welders and fitters mostly read Mandarin, and MOM inspectors see the same documents, so fabrication terminology has to be exact.

You'd also flag anything in the English that's ambiguous or out of step with WSH practice, and walk our production lead through the terminology calls. Deliverable: the full Chinese translation plus a short bilingual glossary. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$4,500-6,000; must be able to start within two weeks of award.

gig_title: Cyber Essentials Mark Readiness Assessment
short_description:
I run a 45-person wholesale distribution business in Singapore — one office, one warehouse, Microsoft 365 and an on-prem file server. We're applying for the CSA Cyber Essentials mark but have no in-house IT team.

I need a consultant to review our access controls, patching, backups and staff awareness practices against the Cyber Essentials checklist and tell us where we stand. Deliverable: a gap assessment report with a prioritised remediation roadmap we can act on. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Data Maturity Review for Licensed Remittance Firm
short_description:
Looking for a data and analytics specialist to review how we handle transaction and customer data. We're a MAS-licensed remittance business with two outlets, roughly 35,000 transfers a month, and records split between our remittance platform, a CRM and Excel. The work: assess data quality, reporting and governance practices against MAS technology risk expectations, identify quick wins, and advise where to invest first.

Deliverable: a written data maturity assessment with a prioritised improvement roadmap for management.
Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Design and Validate Contact Lens Subscription Pilot
short_description:
We run three optometry shops in Singapore and want to test a contact lens subscription plan before committing to it. We need a service designer to sharpen the concept, run quick interviews with 8-10 existing customers, draft the service blueprint and two or three pricing tiers, and prepare a costed pilot for one shop.

The signup journey should exist as a clickable prototype with a PDPA-compliant consent step built in. Management wants something concrete to greenlight or drop, not a deck of possibilities. Deliverable: a pilot pack — validated concept, service blueprint, pricing tiers, clickable signup prototype, and a one-page costed pilot plan. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Response to IPOS Written Opinion for Water-Quality Patent
short_description:
We are a small Singapore manufacturer of portable water-quality testing devices, with one patent application now in examination at IPOS. The examiner's written opinion raises novelty and clarity objections across twelve claims. We need a registered patent agent to go through each objection with us, advise where an argument is realistic and where claims should be narrowed, then draft and file the response with amended claims via IP2SG. We want straight advice on how much protection is actually worth fighting for.

Deliverable: the filed response to the written opinion, with amended claims and a short note on the options we set aside. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Membership Database Clean-Up for Trade Association
short_description:
Looking for a data entry specialist to clean up our membership database. We're a Singapore trade association with about 380 member companies and a five-person secretariat. Member details sit in three Excel files, a stack of renewal forms and an old system export — roughly 1,400 contact rows.

You'd merge everything into one master list, remove duplicates, standardise company names and UEN numbers, key in the form backlog, and update PDPA consent flags. Where companies have renamed or merged, records conflict, so those calls need judgement, not guesswork. Deliverable: one cleaned Excel master list, a change log, and doubtful records flagged. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Redesign of Digital Delivery Client Deck
short_description:
Our client briefing deck needs a full redesign. We're a small Singapore BIM consultancy (about 14 staff) working with contractors on BCA's Integrated Digital Delivery requirements. The deck runs to 30 slides — dense text, mismatched charts, and screenshots from Revit and our common data environment.

We need a presentation designer to review it, diagnose what's confusing, and rebuild the structure and visuals for live client presentations. Deliverable: a redesigned PowerPoint deck with editable master layouts, plus a one-page note recommending how we keep future decks consistent. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: HSA Product Classification Opinion for Supplement Line
short_description:
We import and wholesale health supplements and traditional remedies to pharmacies and Chinese medicine halls across Singapore. We're bringing in a new line and need a pharmacist to review formulations, labels and planned claims, and give a formal opinion under the Health Products Act on whether each SKU is a therapeutic product, supplement or complementary health product, and what HSA notification it needs. About 45 SKUs.

You'd also sit with our ops lead to explain the findings and what to change. Deliverable: a written classification opinion per SKU, plus a summary table of HSA submissions and suggested claim wording. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Planogram Reset for 8-Store Wellness Chain
short_description: We run eight wellness retail stores across Singapore and want our vitamins and supplements category reset ahead of the next range review. You would build bay-by-bay planograms, rationalise roughly 300 SKUs to a tighter core, and draft shelf label copy that stays within HSA advertising rules for supplements — no disease or treatment claims. Deliverable: finished planograms in JDA Space Planning plus a store-ready shelf label copy deck. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Fleet Engineering Assessment for Bus Operator
short_description:
We need an independent engineering assessment of our bus fleet ahead of an LTA compliance review. We're a small charter bus operator, about 55 buses split between diesel and electric, with no fleet engineer on staff.

Review our maintenance records, inspection history and breakdown data, spot-check a sample of vehicles, and tell us whether our preventive maintenance regime is adequate for the mileage we run — each bus does about 300 km a day — where the gaps are, and what to fix first. Deliverable: a written engineering assessment with findings on fleet condition, gaps in the maintenance regime, and prioritised, costed recommendations for the next 12 months. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Job Description Writing for Legal Advisory Practice
short_description: Looking for a writer to draft a set of job descriptions for our twelve-person legal advisory practice in Singapore. You'll run short interviews with each role holder, then write 8 JDs covering lawyers, paralegals and admin support, consistent with TAFEP fair employment guidelines. Deliverable: 8 finalised job descriptions in one shared template, ready for posting. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget: S$1,800-2,500 for the full set.

gig_title: QA/QC Section for Staff Handbook
short_description:
A Singapore specialty chemicals blender with about 45 staff on one production site needs the quality control section of its staff handbook written. You would review our SOPs and ISO 9001:2015 quality manual, then draft the section so production and QC staff actually follow it: incoming raw material checks, batch sampling and testing, GHS labelling verification, out-of-spec handling and record retention. We also want advice on where the handbook should point to SOPs rather than repeat them, and how it lines up with MOM's WSH Act duties.

Deliverable: a 12-15 page handbook section in Word with two process flowcharts and a one-page rollout note for managers. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: ECDA Licensing Gap Review for Early Intervention Centre
short_description:
We run a private early intervention centre in Singapore — around 70 children aged 18 months to 6, with 15 staff across therapy and teaching. We're licensed by ECDA and want an independent view of how we're tracking against its requirements for early intervention centres.

Someone to review our documentation and day-to-day practices: staff qualification records, IEP documentation, incident and safety procedures, parent consent and communication flows. Diagnose the gaps, advise management on what to fix first and what can wait. Deliverable: a written gap assessment with a prioritised remediation roadmap. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$9,000-S$14,000, start within two weeks of award.

gig_title: HACCP Gap Assessment for Biscuit Factory
short_description: We run a family-owned biscuit manufacturing plant in Singapore, about 40 staff on one site, SFA-licensed and currently working to HACCP with plans toward SS 570. We need a QA specialist to review our food safety system — CCP monitoring records, prerequisite programmes, allergen handling and traceability — identify the gaps against the standard, and advise what to fix ahead of certification. Deliverable: a written gap assessment with a prioritised corrective action roadmap. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000–S$8,000; must be able to start on site in early June.

gig_title: Machine Shop Calibration Register and Recall System
short_description:
I run a 30-person precision machining company in Singapore, ISO 9001:2015 certified. I need someone to walk through our workshop and tool crib and build a proper register of our measurement equipment — roughly 120 items: micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, height and thread gauges, plus one CMM.

For each instrument, classify it by criticality, recommend a calibration interval, and advise which ones should go to SAC-accredited labs and what we can verify in-house. Then set up a tagging and recall system the team can actually follow. Deliverable: an Excel calibration register with intervals and next-due dates, plus a short written calibration procedure. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Safety Case for Tug Conversion (MPA Submission)
short_description:
We need a formal safety case for one of our harbour tugs to support an alternate-design approval from MPA. We are a family-run tug and bunkering operator with six harbour craft and no technical department. The specialist would run a HAZID with our master and engineers, assess the converted diesel-electric drive, set out risk controls, and assemble everything in the Authority's submission format.

Deliverable: a complete safety case report, ready to lodge. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Arboriculture Workbook Cleanup and Restructure
short_description: A 10-person arboriculture services company in Singapore manages tree maintenance, NParks permit applications and safety checks for commercial sites. It needs an Excel specialist to clean, restructure and simplify its 6-sheet operations workbook, which currently holds around 4,000 rows of inspection, treatment, crew and permit records. The specialist should identify missing permit fields, duplicate entries, broken links and unclear calculations, then advise management on what to fix first for compliance and reporting. Deliverable: one restructured Excel workbook with cleaned data, a short formula map and a one-page note on data gaps, compliance risks and reporting fixes. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Review of Armed Auxiliary Police Deployment
short_description:
I run a mid-sized logistics company, about 180 staff across two warehouses. We have armed auxiliary police officers at the main distribution centre gatehouse round the clock, and I want an independent review of the deployment: post manning, shift rotation, firearm carriage and handover procedures, and whether the scope matches the licence conditions set by the Police Licensing & Regulatory Department and our guarding agreement.

You should also advise where we're over-manned and what to specify at renewal. Deliverable: a written review report with findings and a right-sized post schedule, plus a walkthrough with me and our facilities lead. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Clean Up and Restructure Learner Records Workbook
short_description:
We need our master learner-tracking workbook reviewed, cleaned up and restructured. We're a small continuing education provider with about 300 learners a term, some on SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG)-funded courses, and this Excel file carries enrolments, attendance and funding-claim records. It is now around 40 interlinked sheets, with duplicate records and formulas that break when we sort or filter.

We want someone to diagnose why it fails, advise what to keep in Excel, recommend a layout that stands up to an SSG audit, then rebuild it. Deliverable: the restructured workbook plus a short memo of recommendations. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Installation Plan for Second CNC Line
short_description:
Need a project plan drawn up for installing a second CNC machining line at our workshop. We are a 12-person precision parts manufacturer; the machines are ordered, so this is about turning the install into a workable programme — sequencing deliveries, rigging and foundation works, the SP Group power supply application, compressed air and ducting, then commissioning and trial runs, with dependencies and lead times mapped out.

Deliverable: a project execution plan (Microsoft Project or Excel) with Gantt chart, milestone schedule and a simple responsibility matrix. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$3,000–S$4,500; looking to start work in early August.

gig_title: IMDA Equipment Registration for Four Sensor SKUs
short_description:
I run a seven-person electronics company that designs LoRa water-level sensors for local farms. We need four sensor variants cleared through IMDA equipment registration before we can sell them.

I need a specialist to map each SKU to the correct equipment class, review our existing RF and EMC test reports for gaps, complete the registration forms, and compile the technical documentation into one submission package per SKU. If test evidence is thin anywhere, flag it clearly rather than paper over it. Deliverable: four completed registration dossiers ready to lodge with IMDA, plus a list of any missing test evidence. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Customer Contact List Clean-Up and Review
short_description:
Our customer list needs a proper tidy-up. We're a 10-person corporate training provider running workshops and in-house programmes for HR teams, and our contact records have grown messy — about 1,600 entries split between Google Sheets and an old Zoho CRM. We need someone good with spreadsheet and CRM data to review the lot, merge duplicates, standardise company names and phone formats, fill missing fields where possible, and flag contacts dormant for two years or more. Also advise us on what to keep, archive or delete under PDPA.

Deliverable: a cleaned, de-duplicated list loaded back into Zoho, plus a one-page note recommending the field structure and a simple upkeep routine. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Review and Rewrite of Warehouse Staff Handbook Section
short_description:
We're a small 3PL operation in Singapore with two warehouses and about 40 staff. Our staff handbook's warehouse operations section is out of date.

We want someone to review the current wording, check how receiving, putaway and dispatch actually run on the floor, and recommend an updated section, flagging anything that conflicts with MOM's Employment Act. Deliverable: a short written assessment plus recommended replacement text we can adopt in-house. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$2,500-4,000, negotiable.

gig_title: Front Office SOP Manual for Boutique Hotel
short_description:
A 40-room boutique hotel in Singapore with a six-person front desk needs someone to document its front office procedures. The work covers check-in and check-out, passport scanning and guest data handling under PDPA, room allocation, luggage storage, shift handovers, and how common complaints get escalated.

You'd spend the first few days observing the desk, then draft each procedure as clear step-by-step instructions with checklists the team can actually follow. Deliverable: a front office SOP manual of 12-15 procedures in editable Word, plus one-page quick-reference cards for the desk. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Travel Trade Pitch Pack for Boutique Hotel
short_description:
We're an STB-licensed 26-room boutique hotel with a rooftop bar and no in-house sales. We want a slice of the MICE and travel trade market and have nothing to put in front of a buyer.

The job is to build the trade pitch: a rate sheet with FIT and group rates, a one-page fact sheet, a 10-slide partnership deck, and a commission structure we can defend. Draft the first three outreach emails for DMCs and corporate bookers. Deliverable: the finished trade pack and outreach emails, handed over as editable files. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000–9,000; need to start by early next month.

gig_title: Video Streaming Delivery Chain Review
short_description:
We run a small IMDA-licensed video streaming service — about 18,000 subscribers, 6,000 hours of VOD, evening peaks near 3,000 concurrent streams. We need an independent review of our delivery chain (encoding ladder, packaging and origin, CDN configuration, player settings) to diagnose why playback quality varies so much between fibre and mobile viewers, and to recommend the changes with the biggest impact.

You would work from our configs, monitoring dashboards and a sample of traced sessions. Deliverable: a written assessment with root-cause findings and a prioritised recommendation list. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: bizSAFE Level 3 Risk Assessments and WSH Programme
short_description:
A family-run furniture workshop with about 25 staff and one production site is applying for bizSAFE Level 3. It needs a WSH specialist to walk the floor, map around ten work activities — sawing, sanding, spray finishing, delivery — write the risk assessments required under the Workplace Safety and Health Act, and advise which controls are actually workable for a small operation.

Brief two supervisors so the audit isn't a surprise. Deliverable: a completed risk assessment register and a WSH management programme document, in editable format. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Bubble Tea Costing and Pricing Review
short_description: Looking for a beverage consultant to review costing and pricing across our six SFA-licensed bubble tea kiosks. We have no one in-house for this. Go through our recipes, supplier invoices and POS data, work out true cost per cup, flag where margins are off, and recommend new prices plus a tighter menu mix. We are a family-run business with about 25 staff. Deliverable: a pricing recommendation report with per-drink cost cards and expected margin impact. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Greenhouse Gas Inventory for Precision Manufacturer
short_description:
Looking for a carbon specialist to build our first greenhouse gas inventory. We're a precision engineering firm with one factory, about 120 staff, and nobody in-house for sustainability.

You would gather electricity, diesel and LPG data from utility bills and site logs, calculate Scope 1 and 2 emissions to the GHG Protocol, estimate the main upstream Scope 3 categories, and keep the numbers consistent with our NEA reporting under the Carbon Pricing Act. Deliverable: an audit-ready emissions workbook in Excel plus a two-page methodology memo. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: HSA GMP Inspection Response and CAPA Plan
short_description: I run a small sterile fill-finish biopharma manufacturer in Singapore, roughly 35 staff, one production line. We have HSA GMP inspection observations to answer, and I need a QA specialist to draft the formal written responses — point-by-point rationale, root cause conclusions, and supporting references — and advise my team on the CAPA plan and evidence pack behind it. Deliverable: a regulator-ready written response for each observation, plus a consolidated CAPA plan. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: SAR-145 Compliance Gap Review for Aircraft Maintenance Organisation
short_description:
We run a CAAS-approved maintenance organisation in Singapore, one hangar, about 35 staff, keeping business jets and turboprops airworthy. We need a specialist to review our maintenance procedures, quality system and training records against SAR-145, run a gap assessment across shop floor and paperwork, and advise management on what to fix first.

Deliverable: a written gap analysis rating findings by severity with a prioritised remediation plan. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Kitchen Town Gas Schematic and Appliance Register
short_description:
A family-run coffee shop with 14 cooked-food stalls, all on piped town gas, needs a gas systems person to walk our kitchen lines, verify every valve, regulator and appliance tap against what's actually installed, and draft a clean as-built schematic of the reticulation. Build us an appliance register too — each wok range, steamer and rice line with make, model and isolation point — so quarterly checks and the EMA periodic gas inspection are straightforward. We can arrange kitchen access outside service hours.

Deliverable: an A3 as-built gas schematic (PDF plus editable source file) and a completed appliance and isolation-point register. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$2,000–2,800 all-in.

gig_title: Excel Workbook Restructure for Cleaning Operations
short_description:
I run an NEA-licensed cleaning company with about 60 cleaners across a dozen client contracts. Our master Excel workbook — rosters, timesheets, overtime, client billing — is now 20-plus tabs of broken formulas and duplicated records. I need someone to clean the data, rebuild it into a structured workbook supervisors can maintain, and advise what should eventually move out of Excel.

Deliverable: a restructured workbook, a short user guide, and a one-page advisory note for management. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$4,500-6,000; must be able to start within two weeks of award.

gig_title: Rigging Safety Review for Theatre Flying System
short_description: Looking for a theatre rigging specialist to assess the flying system in our independent 320-seat playhouse ahead of a season that includes aerial work. Review the counterweight system, lines, pulleys and loading practices, check our inspection and maintenance records, and advise what can safely be flown and what must change. The written opinion needs to stand up to our insurer and to scrutiny under the Workplace Safety and Health Act. Deliverable: a written rigging safety assessment with prioritised recommendations and load limits per bar. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Case File Documentation Review for Family Service Charity
short_description: We need 30 closed case files reviewed and brought up to MSF documentation standards. You'd go through each record at our small family service charity (one social worker on staff), fix missing entries, flag follow-ups, and note consent gaps. Where recording falls short of the SASW Code of Ethics, redraft it. Deliverable: 30 corrected files plus a findings memo ranking gaps by risk. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Staff Handbook Safety Section for Vegetable Farm
short_description:
I run a 30-worker vegetable farm in Singapore. I need our staff handbook's safety section reviewed against the Workplace Safety and Health Act and our SFA licence conditions, then rewritten to cover agrochemical handling, machinery use and heat stress.

Advise us too on briefing supervisors and getting workers to sign off. Deliverable: a plain-English safety section of 8-10 pages plus a one-page memo of gaps found and recommended fixes. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Sales Margin Review by Customer Channel
short_description:
Looking for a business analyst to review our sales margins by customer channel. We're an SFA-licensed food wholesaler with 15 staff supplying minimarts, cafes and a few supermarkets. You'll use 12 months of sales and cost data in Xero and Excel, build a margin breakdown by channel and product group, flag loss-making lines, and advise us on where to focus business development next.

Deliverable: a margin analysis workbook plus a one-page recommendations memo and a walkthrough session. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.
