gig_title: HACCP Plan Rebuild for Changi Flight Kitchen
short_description:
We run a flight catering kitchen at Changi, around 8,000 meals a day for 14 airlines. We need a food safety specialist to rebuild our HACCP plan: walk the hot, cold and assembly lines with QA, redraw the process flow diagrams, redo the hazard analysis and CCP determination for the current menu, and draft matching monitoring, corrective action and verification records.

It has to satisfy SFA licensing and stand up to airline customer audits. Deliverable: a revised HACCP plan pack — flow diagrams, hazard analysis worksheets, CCP determination, monitoring and verification forms — audit-ready. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Preliminary Financial Review of Acquisition Target
short_description: Looking for an accountant with M&A experience to run a preliminary financial review of a small F&B business we may acquire. You would review three years of management accounts and GST filings with IRAS, check revenue recognition and related-party items against SFRS, flag anything that would affect the price, and give an indicative valuation range. We are a family-owned group with five outlets and no finance team beyond a bookkeeper. Deliverable: a written assessment memo (10-15 pages) covering findings, red flags and a valuation range in S$. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Schedule Assessment for Tug Refit
short_description:
Looking for a marine project specialist to assess a vessel refit programme that has slipped. We are a small tug operator running three harbour tugs; conversion of one vessel, including scrubber installation, is halfway through with MPA and class sign-off pending.

Need an independent read on the yard's revised programme, critical path and completion outlook, and advice on what to hold the yard to at the next milestone. Deliverable: a written schedule and delay assessment with findings, risks and recommended actions, plus a briefing to our directors. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$12,000–15,000 all-in.

gig_title: Transcribe and Summarise Infrastructure Meeting Recordings
short_description:
I run a 25-person managed infrastructure services firm and need about a dozen recorded internal meetings transcribed and summarised for management. The recordings run 45–60 minutes each — post-incident review calls, vendor discussions, upgrade planning sessions — roughly 12 hours of audio.

I need someone to transcribe them accurately (plenty of technical jargon), then review the transcripts, pull out the main issues raised and advise on priorities. Recordings include client names, so handle them in line with PDPA. Deliverable: a written report with a summary of each recording, the themes across them, and prioritised recommendations for management. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$1,500–2,000; can start any time from mid-July.

gig_title: Annual Client Asset Return (CASS) for Fund Manager
short_description:
We run a small licensed fund management company in Singapore, about a dozen staff across three private funds. We need someone to prepare the annual client asset return under MAS CASS. That means pulling together statements from two custodians and five bank accounts, reconciling them against the fund administrator's records, working through the breaks, and drafting the return with supporting schedules.

Deliverable: completed CASS return with reconciled schedules and working papers, ready for lodgement. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Staff Handbook Section: Working Hours and Leave
short_description:
A five-outlet F&B group in Singapore needs one section of its staff handbook rewritten. The section covers working hours, overtime and leave.

We need a writer to draft it so it lines up with the Employment Act and our current shift practices, and reads like the rest of the handbook. You would work from our shift notes and policies, then fold in one round of comments. Deliverable: a 2,000-word section in Word, ready to drop into the handbook. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Response to IPOS Written Opinion on PCT Application
short_description:
I run a small medtech startup in Singapore. We have one PCT application where IPOS, as International Searching Authority, has raised inventive step objections against three prior art citations. I need a patent prosecution specialist to assess the objections, propose amended claims that keep the core invention intact, and draft the written response for filing. You would also advise on divisional filings and claim scope before national phase entry.

Deliverable: a filing-ready written response with an amended claim set. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Member Survey Analysis and Sector Report
short_description:
An industry association representing around 350 SMEs in the built-environment supply chain needs a research specialist to analyse its recently closed member survey — 140 responses covering manpower, sub-contracting costs and tender pipelines over the past two years. You would clean and code the raw data, run cross-tabs by firm size and trade, and draft a sector pulse report for members plus a two-page summary for an upcoming MOM manpower engagement.

Deliverable: a 20-25 page report with charts, the cleaned dataset, and the two-page summary. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget: S$6,500–S$8,000 all-in.

gig_title: Customer List Clean-Up for Main Contractor
short_description:
Looking for a data specialist to clean up our customer list. We're a BCA-registered main contractor with about 2,000 records in Excel — duplicates, stale contacts, patchy consent fields — plus a stack of business cards never keyed in.

You'd review each record, merge duplicates, verify company names and UENs, enter the card contacts, and flag anything with missing or unclear marketing consent under PDPA. There's judgement in what to keep, merge or archive — some records feed live tender bids, so we'd rather you ask than guess. Deliverable: a cleaned, de-duplicated master list plus a short data-quality assessment for management, with recommendations on consent records and ongoing upkeep. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Knee Osteoarthritis Home Exercise Progression Plan
short_description: We need a physiotherapy specialist to set up a standardised knee osteoarthritis home exercise progression plan for a 6-therapist outpatient clinic handling 40 knee osteoarthritis referrals per month. The work is to review intake notes, draft an 8-week exercise plan covering walking, strengthening, and mobility exercises, set progression criteria and red flags, include a patient handout, and advise on where the plan fits into intake and discharge documentation. Deliverable: one editable PDF, spreadsheet tool, and usage note for therapists. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Brand Architecture Review for F&B Group
short_description:
We run three restaurant brands under one family company — nine outlets islandwide, plus an online shop for sauces and merchandise. We need a brand strategist to advise whether the three should stay separate, merge, or sit under one master brand.

You'd audit how each brand appears across menus, signage, packaging and social media, check our trademark registrations with IPOS, and build a few positioning options with rough rebrand costs in S$. You'll present to the owners and talk us through the trade-offs. Deliverable: a brand architecture report with a recommended option, positioning statements and a cost estimate. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Admin and Inbox Backlog Review for Bus Operator
short_description:
We have fallen behind on admin and need a specialist to review the backlog. We run about 25 buses on contract shuttle routes with 40 staff. Around 1,500 unread emails, LTA correspondence, permit renewals and driver records have piled up.

Review it all, flag anything non-compliant with our operator licence conditions, and recommend how to keep it clear. Deliverable: a prioritised clearance plan with a risk assessment of overdue items. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Mystery Shopping of Law Practice Branch Intake
short_description:
Four-branch Singapore law practice focused on family and probate matters needs an independent review of how prospective clients are handled from first contact. You would develop the enquiry scenarios and assessment checklist yourself, then mystery-shop all four branches — walk-in and phone — as a would-be client, and assess the experience against Law Society of Singapore requirements on fee transparency, conflicts checks, engagement letters and consent at intake. We want a candid read on consistency across branches, not a box-ticking exercise.

Deliverable: a written assessment scoring each branch against the checklist, with prioritised recommendations to standardise intake and staff scripts. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Inbox Backlog Clear-Out for Chemical Blending Plant
short_description:
We blend and pack speciality cleaning chemicals for industrial customers — one plant, about 40 staff. Our shared mailboxes hold roughly 300 unread items: overdue NEA replies on emission returns and our hazardous substances licence, customer requests for safety data sheets, and internal approvals going nowhere. We need someone to triage the lot, draft replies for our sign-off, close what can be closed, and advise which items genuinely need an engineer's or director's eye.

Deliverable: mailboxes cleared, every item answered, archived or logged in one Excel tracker with status, owner and next step. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Developmental Assessments and Reports for Eight Children
short_description:
I run a small ECDA-licensed early intervention centre in Singapore, about 40 children on our caseload and 9 staff. I need a specialist to run formal developmental assessments for eight children, aged 3 to 6, whose families are applying for early intervention programme places. Each case means reading our therapy and session notes, choosing and administering suitable tools (the Vineland-3 or PEP-3, say), scoring them, and writing up findings, goals and recommendations the family can act on.

Deliverable: eight completed assessment reports with scores, developmental profiles and written recommendations. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Go/No-Go Review for Ready-to-Eat Plant-Based Line
short_description:
We need a go/no-go review of a ready-to-eat plant-based line before it enters major Singapore supermarket and foodservice channels.
Review three SKUs, current SFA licence scope, production capacity, cost structure, and channel margin requirements. Check supply readiness for a 12-week sell-in and talk with two category buyers.
Deliverable: a one-page go/no-go opinion with a prioritised fix list and a 90-day launch sequence.
Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: CNC Shaft Scrap Rate Diagnosis
short_description:
We run a small CNC machining shop (about 20 staff) and need someone to diagnose why one shaft part we machine at 8,000 pieces a month keeps failing final inspection. Review the turning and measurement steps, check our gauge set-up and SPC records, and advise whether the fault lies with process, tooling or calibration under ISO 9001.

Deliverable: a written assessment with recommended fixes for management to act on. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Copy-Edit of Port Operations Manual
short_description: Looking for a copy-editor to proofread and tidy up our 130-page vessel operations manual. It covers berthing, towage and crew procedures and is written by several hands, so tone and terminology are inconsistent. The job: fix grammar, spelling and punctuation, standardise terms (we use MPA and IMO jargon throughout), flag anything unclear or contradictory, and keep the formatting intact. We will supply the style guide and a glossary. Deliverable: a clean copy-edited version plus a tracked-changes Word file with a short list of flagged queries. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$1,500–S$2,500 depending on the number of revision rounds.

gig_title: Landscape Layout for Outdoor Dining Terrace
short_description:
We are a small Singapore café operator with one outlet. We need a landscape designer to redesign our 60 sqm rear outdoor dining terrace shared with a delivery bay. The work is to check existing drainage, seating, service circulation, and plant positions, then set out a layout that keeps 8 guest tables, one staff staging area, and a clear fire lane. You should advise on low-maintenance tropical plants, irrigation, drainage, and build materials for contractors.

Deliverable: an A1 landscape layout plan with a planting schedule, materials list, and a one-page maintenance note.
Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Data Protection Gap Review and Fix Plan for Dental Clinic
short_description: We are a 25-person dental clinic in Singapore providing private dental care, with two treatment rooms and a mixed setup of paper records and one main practice management system. We need an information security consultant to review current patient data flows under PDPA, check access in the practice system and shared drives, interview the practice manager and two clinicians, test export and deletion settings, and prepare a management-ready fix plan for data protection, breach response, and vendor sharing. Deliverable: a finished gap register, risk-rated 12-week remediation schedule, access-control matrix, and three draft SOPs covering patient data, consent, and data destruction. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget: S$8,000 to S$12,000.

gig_title: Adult course assessment and PDPA gap review
short_description:
We are a small Singapore training provider running subsidised digital skills courses for adult learners. One blended course has 120 participants a year, so we need an adult education specialist to review its assessment design, learner support records, and PDPA handling.

Please test the assessment flow using sample learner files, flag where outcomes are not properly evidenced, and advise management on fixes for course improvement. Deliverable: a 12-page findings report with prioritised fixes and a 45-minute debrief. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Transcription and Summary of Maintenance Meeting Recordings
short_description:
We run planned air-conditioning and electrical maintenance for about 30 commercial buildings across Singapore. We have roughly 12 hours of recordings — monthly operations review calls, site-walk discussions and toolbox briefings, some taken in noisy plant rooms — that need transcribing and summarising into a clean operations record. Beyond the transcription itself, we need someone who can read across the summaries, spot recurring equipment faults and gaps against MOM's Workplace Safety and Health Act, and advise our management team on what to fix first.

Deliverable: verified transcripts, a one-page summary per recording, a consolidated action-item log, and a short advisory note walked through with management in a one-hour call. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Independent ESD Gap Assessment for SMT Plant
short_description:
A small contract electronics manufacturer in Singapore, about 60 staff in one plant, builds PCB assemblies for medical and industrial customers on two SMT lines plus a manual assembly cell.

We need an independent ESD control assessment of the whole production floor against IEC 61340-5-1. Walk the floor with our quality lead, review earthing, wrist-strap and ioniser regimes, check EPA boundaries and signage, and judge our current handling practices against the standard. Deliverable: a written gap assessment with findings graded by risk and a prioritised remediation list we can start on. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: HR System Recommendation for F&B Group
short_description:
We need advice on choosing an HR system for our shift-based staff. We're a family-run F&B group with four outlets and about 60 employees, mostly part-timers on rotating rosters. Leave, attendance and claims currently run on WhatsApp, Excel and paper forms.

Review these processes, flag what should stay manual, and recommend two or three suitable systems with indicative monthly costs in S$. Deliverable: a short recommendation covering the shortlist, costs, PDPA points on staff data, and a simple rollout plan. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Customer Service Escalation Review for Freight Forwarder
short_description:
I run a family-owned freight forwarder in Singapore, 45 staff, about 300 shipments a month. I need an independent specialist to assess why quoted transit times keep turning into complaints — reviewing our sales commitments, complaint records and escalation process against ISO 10002 — and to advise my ops lead on changes.

Deliverable: a written assessment for the board with root causes, gap findings and a prioritised fix list. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000–8,000; can start from 10 March.

gig_title: OTA Mapping and Channel Manager Setup for Boutique Hotel
short_description:
A 42-room family-run boutique hotel, licensed under the Hotels Act, manages its OTA listings by hand and wants a channel manager set up properly. It needs a specialist to map its four room types and rate plans across Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia and Trip.com in SiteMinder, connect the PMS, and check parity and content on each channel. Along the way, advise on which promotions and member rates make sense.

Deliverable: SiteMinder mapped and synced across all four OTAs, plus a handover note the front desk can follow. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Hotel Keeper's Licence Application for Boutique Hotel
short_description:
We are a family property owner opening a 38-room boutique hotel across three conservation shophouses. We need a hotel licensing specialist to prepare and submit the Hotel Keeper's licence application to STB under the Hotels Act — drafting the rate schedule, guest registration and check-in procedures that line up with ICA requirements, house rules, and the fire safety evidence SCDF will want.

Deliverable: a submission-ready licence application pack with all supporting schedules. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Recording Corner Setup for Tuition Centre
short_description: We need a small recording corner at our tuition centre set up and working. Gear is mostly bought: two PTZ cameras, lavalier mic, mixer, lights. You would mount and wire everything, set up the capture laptop and OBS scenes, then do a test shoot with one of our tutors. There's S$500 for mounts and cabling. Deliverable: the installed and tested setup, plus a one-page settings sheet our staff can follow. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: SS 651 Safety Management System Audit
short_description:
We run a chemicals blending and packing facility with about 30 staff on one site. We need an independent WSH auditor to review our safety and health management system against SS 651 and WSH Act requirements — walk the production floor, check risk assessments, PPE and chemical exposure records, spill drill logs and permit-to-work files, and interview supervisors.

You would classify the non-conformities and present findings to management with recommended fixes. Deliverable: an audit report with a prioritised corrective action plan. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Pastry Costing and Margin Review
short_description: We're a family-run bakery with three outlets and a small SFA-licensed central kitchen, baking around 60 types of breads and pastries daily. We want a specialist to review costing and margins across the whole range: go through recipes, ingredient prices, batch yields, wastage and prep time, spend a day in the kitchen watching production, and advise management on where we're losing money. Deliverable: a written report with per-item costing, margin analysis and recommendations on what to reprice, reformulate or drop, plus a simple costing template we can keep using. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Carbon Credit and Insurance Cover Tracking Dashboard
short_description: We run a small carbon trading practice in Singapore (eight staff), brokering credits from regional forestry and cookstove projects and placing insurance cover on a few of them. We need someone to review our contracts, retirement records and cover notes, diagnose the gaps in our tracking, and build a simple Excel or Power BI dashboard management can use. Deliverable: a working dashboard plus a one-page note recommending which metrics to watch for NEA reporting under the Carbon Pricing Act. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: CMMS Setup for Plant Utilities
short_description:
We operate a small biopharma contract manufacturing site in Tuas with two cleanroom production suites and a utilities area. We're HSA-licensed and work to cGMP. We need one specialist to set up planned maintenance in our Fiix CMMS for the utilities — purified water, cleanroom HVAC and compressed air. You'll build the asset register from existing equipment lists, draft PM tasks with sensible frequencies, and load everything into the system.

Deliverable: a configured CMMS with a full asset register and PM schedules, plus printable work order templates. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000–8,000 for the full engagement.

gig_title: Nadcap Audit Response for Chemical Processing Findings
short_description: I run a 30-person metal finishing shop in Singapore doing aerospace work. Our Nadcap chemical processing audit returned 11 nonconformances and I need someone to draft the full response: root cause analysis on each finding, rewrites of the affected work instructions and process specifications, and compilation of objective evidence such as training records, tank logs and process control charts into PRI's eAuditNet format. Deliverable: a submission-ready response package covering all findings, with corrected procedures attached. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: EMA Electricity Import Licence Compliance Gap Review
short_description:
I run a six-person energy trading company in Singapore with conditional EMA approval to import low-carbon electricity. I need someone to go through our Electricity Importer Licence conditions clause by clause, check what we already meet and what is outstanding — carbon intensity limits, metering and reporting obligations, our decarbonisation plan submissions — and flag where the regulator could push back.

Then draft the missing documents with me, not just hand over a findings list. Deliverable: a gap register with severity ratings plus first drafts of the three to four submissions it identifies. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Recovery Rate Review for Mixed Recyclables Sorting Yard
short_description:
A family-run recycling company with about 50 staff operates a single sorting yard, processing around 350 tonnes of mixed recyclables a month. We need an independent specialist to review the recovery process: analyse contamination and rejection data, walk the sorting line, and diagnose why our recovery rate has stalled at 60% against a 75% target, then advise on low-capital fixes and flag any gaps with NEA licensing conditions.

Deliverable: an assessment report with root-cause findings, benchmarked figures and prioritised recommendations. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Rigging Safety Review for Black Box Theatre
short_description: Our 120-seat black box theatre in a conservation shophouse needs a rigging safety review. Inspect the grid, flying bars, winches and anchor points, check the loads we fly against safe working limits, and advise what to fix, replace or derig so loads can go back over performers, in line with the Workplace Safety and Health Act. Deliverable: a written condition report with load assessments, ranked remedial actions and photographs. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: PDPA Gap Review for Youth Casework Records
short_description: A youth charity runs a drop-in centre and school outreach programme for at-risk teens, with eight staff handling casework. We need a specialist to review how our intake forms, case notes and referrals meet PDPA consent requirements and NCSS case management standards, flag the gaps, and advise management on practical fixes and staff practices. Deliverable: a written gap assessment with prioritised recommendations and a revised consent form. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Post-Harvest Spoilage Review for Vegetable Farm
short_description:
Our small family-run vegetable farm is SFA-licensed and grows leafy greens for grocers and wet markets, roughly 800 kg a week. We want a specialist to review our post-harvest handling, from field crates through washing, packing and cold storage, to find out where quality losses come from. Losses currently run 15-20% between harvest and delivery, which we think is too high for leafy veg. The work would involve a day or two on-site observing each step, checking temperatures and handling times, then writing up what you find.

Deliverable: a written assessment identifying the main causes of spoilage, with prioritised, practical recommendations we can act on. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$1,500-2,500, with an earliest start date of 2 June.

gig_title: Sales Deck Redesign for Hardware Distributor
short_description:
A family-run trading company supplying industrial fasteners and hardware to contractors across Singapore runs its sales meetings off a 35-slide PowerPoint that has outgrown itself — mismatched fonts, cramped price tables, patchy product photos. Looking for a freelancer to rework the deck: tighten the narrative, cut what doesn't earn its place, rebuild layouts, charts and product pages, and advise the six-person sales team on tailoring the master deck for different customer types.

Deliverable: a redesigned 25-30 slide sales deck in editable PowerPoint, plus a one-page style guide for future edits. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Passenger Handling Manual for CAAS AOC Application
short_description: I run a two-aircraft charter start-up preparing our first Air Operator Certificate application with CAAS. I need a passenger services specialist to draft the passenger handling section of our operations manual — boarding, special assistance, unaccompanied minors, denied boarding, irregular operations — and advise us through CAAS review comments until it's accepted. Deliverable: a submission-ready passenger handling manual section with its referenced forms and notices, plus written replies to CAAS queries. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$22,000–28,000 for the full engagement.

gig_title: Internal Audit of Procurement and Donation Controls
short_description: I run a social service charity with about 30 staff across two centres, funded by grants and public donations. I need an independent internal audit of our procurement and donation-handling controls: review how purchases are approved, how cash and cheque donations are receipted and banked, and where we fall short of the Code of Governance for Charities and IPCs.
